-- 1. Crear la credencial
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL cred_ABL
WITH
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';
GO

-- 2. Crear el origen de datos externo (Silver)
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_silver
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://lakeylakey3.dfs.core.windows.net/silver',
    CREDENTIAL = cred_ABL
);
GO

-- 3. Crear el sink de los datos (Gold)
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_gold
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://lakeylakey3.dfs.core.windows.net/gold',
    CREDENTIAL = cred_ABL
);
GO

-- 4. Crear el formato de archivo Parquet
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT format_parquet
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
);
GO

--------------------------------------
--create external table EXTSALES

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.extsales
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'external sales',
    DATA_SOURCE =  source_gold,
    FILE_FORMAT = format_parquet,
)
AS
SELECT * FROM gold.sales

select * from gold.sales
